description: Palbase is a backend for web, iOS and Android apps: auth, Postgres, storage, realtime, feature flags, notifications, analytics, AI and in-app purchases, with a TypeScript backend framework (palbase/backend) deployed by git push, web and server SDKs (palbase/web, palbase/server), Swift and Kotlin SDKs, and the palbase CLI.
rules: Install the JavaScript SDK and CLI from the npm package palbase; import palbase/web in apps, palbase/server on servers and palbase/backend in a backend.
A backend is deployed by pushing to the GitHub branch its machine is connected to; palbase machines:deploy only builds that branch's head again.
Every route of a palbase/backend app requires a signed-in user unless it says otherwise.
Use the publishable key (pb_<ref>_c…) in apps and the secret key (pb_<ref>_s…) only on servers.
